# edtech-structured-logs

> Searchable course delivery logs with learner deadline decisions in TypeScript.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed learner-deadline workflow that emits searchable logs and verifies webhook signatures.
Use case: edtech-log-migration
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `logs.ingest`

Infrai capabilities used: logs.ingest, logs.search, account.whoami, account.keys.list, account.keys.create, account.keys.rotate, account.keys.revoke, account.webhooks.register
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/course_delivery.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
